Kenney City Kit Commercial 2.1, CC0
https://kenney.nl/assets/city-kit-commercial
Geometry preserved. Original gradient atlas sampled into linear vertex colors.
Glass and wall material regions allow lighting and facade color variation.
All GLB files are self-contained; no external textures or remote requests.

Additional city assets, all CC0:
Kenney City Kit Industrial 2.0 — https://kenney.nl/assets/city-kit-industrial
Kenney City Kit Suburban 2.0 — https://kenney.nl/assets/city-kit-suburban
Kenney Nature Kit — https://kenney.nl/assets/nature-kit
Each subdirectory includes the original License.txt. Selected industrial and suburban palette textures are baked into linear vertex colors, preserving original geometry. Nature materials have nonmetallic roughness for outdoor lighting.
